name: Zhe Jiang Dali Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhe Jiang Dali Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of uncooled focal plane detectors, infrared thermal imaging systems, inspection robots, and inertial navigation optoelectronic products in the People's Republic of China. The company offers hand-held thermal imager and camera; on-line thermal, dual-spectrum, temperature measurement, and thermal network bullet camera; and special equipment, such and fire fighting and detection thermal imager, coal mining safety detection, acoustic camera and imaging system, and thermal and acoustic imaging camera.
